ValidationRule.description: Account name validation rule: prohibit illegal characters / ? < > \ : * “ ^
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "/"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "?"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "<"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, ">"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "\\"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, ":"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "*"), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "\""), CONTAINS(Account_Name__c, "^") )
